sources.note: Whole-body context for the Visible Human male: the NLM Visible Human Project cryosection dataset (0.33 mm/pixel). This row is the graph's body-level parent and nothing resolves to it. It is deliberately NOT review-accepted: its label is 'Human body' while UBERON:0000468 is 'multicellular organism' — not the same claim — and it has no layer of its own.

HuBMAP HRA ref-organ heart GLBs (male v1.3 + female v1.3), loaded by the app from the HuBMAP CDN. Neither asset publishes a whole-organ heart mesh: each is three groups carrying fourteen individually-named meshes (four chambers, four valves, the interventricular septum and five papillary muscles), which are mapped as their own rows. Nothing resolves to this row itself.

Z-Anatomy 'Skeletal system' collection. The bones of the skull, the vertebral column (atlas and axis through L5, sacrum and coccyx), the ribs, the sternum, the shoulder girdle and arms, and the pelvis and legs are mapped as their own structures. NOT mapped yet: the bones of the hand and foot, the three ear ossicles, the teeth, and the laryngeal, nasal and costal cartilages, which are cartilage rather than bone.

Z-Anatomy 'Muscular system' collection. 132 of its muscles are mapped as their own structures, each with a Uberon id verified by exact label against OLS4. NOT mapped: muscles Uberon does not model, or models only as part of a named group (e.g. extensor indicis, corrugator supercilii, and named heads and bellies such as the clavicular head of pectoralis major), and the 62 connective-tissue sheets the collection carries alongside the muscle bellies (fascia, aponeurosis, retinaculum; e.g. Epicranial aponeurosis, Fascia lata, the thoracolumbar layers), excluded by explicit object name because they are not muscle and they sat at or above skin level. Tensor fasciae latae is kept (a muscle). 607 mesh nodes.

Z-Anatomy 'Visceral systems' collection (R2 visceral-v1-draco.glb) — the modelling meshes (118 surface objects: liver + its segments, gallbladder, stomach, pancreas, kidneys, urinary bladder, lung lobes, pleura, trachea, thyroid and parathyroid glands, salivary glands, tongue, palate, pharynx, pituitary and pineal glands, and that individual's male reproductive organs) PLUS curve-converted tubes that are equally real geometry: the segmental and lobar bronchi, the oesophagus, the jejunum, the bile duct, the pancreatic and accessory pancreatic ducts, the parotid and submandibular ducts, the ductus deferens, the ejaculatory ducts, the ureters and the urethra. Ten structures have their own rows (liver, stomach, pancreas, gallbladder, kidney, urinary bladder, trachea, thyroid gland, adrenal gland, lung) so those clicks open an entry; everything else in this layer still reports not-in-this-dataset.

The source also names a separate 'Accessory pancreatic duct' mesh, which is left unmapped — and that is a deliberate choice, NOT a missing term. CORRECTED 2026-09-13: this note previously said no matching Uberon term was found, which the ontology contradicts. OLS4's curator note on UBERON:0007329 reads 'this class groups together accessory (dorsal) and main (ventral) pancreatic ducts', and that term's own description lists 'duct of pancreas', 'ductus pancreaticus' and 'pancreas duct' as synonyms. So the class does cover the accessory duct, and mapping both meshes to it would make one structure row stand for two separately named ducts that drain to different papillae; the accessory duct is therefore left unmapped and disclosed in the card instead. UBERON:0001064 remains the VENTRAL pancreatic duct on its own and was not used. Uberon id verified against OLS4 (label 'pancreatic duct', not obsolete).

sources.note: Z-Anatomy 'Cardiovascular system' collection (R2 cardiovascular-v1-draco.glb) — 676 surface nodes: heart chambers, valves, papillary muscles, pulmonary trunk, dural sinuses, plus 654 vessel tubes converted from beveled curves, i.e. the arterial and venous tree including distal limb coverage. Distinct from the HuBMAP blood-vasculature row, which is a different individual and trunk-only. 229 of this layer's 416 named vessels are mapped as their own structures, each id accepted only on an exact Uberon label or exact synonym; the other 166 are segmental vessels and named branches Uberon does not model. The heart's own parts are claimed by the heart rows instead (the four chambers from this layer, the valves and the interventricular septum from the donors' heart assets), and the valve LEAFLETS this layer names stay unmapped because a leaflet is a part of a valve.

Z-Anatomy 'Nervous system & Sense organs' collection (R2 nervous-v1-draco.glb) — 580 surface nodes: brain surfaces, spinal cord parts, spinal dura, cranial and peripheral nerve tubes (247 converted from beveled curves). 160 of the layer's 315 names are mapped as their own structures, each id accepted only on an exact Uberon label or exact synonym; the other 155 are named nerves Uberon lacks, structures Uberon names with a qualifier its synonyms do not shorten to the asset's word, and a few of the source's own atlas abbreviations. Honest gap: the eye's ciliary body has NO surface geometry in this source (its two curves are unbeveled and were dropped).
